note: Three different exposures and three different questions: essential oils of Origanum dubium and O. vulgare hirtum in 34 athletes (HDL-C up over 14 days), oregano phenolics in fortified juice at 300-600 mg/day which was NULL on serum lipids and lipid peroxidation, and a network meta-analysis in which O. vulgare was best for chronic rhinosinusitis without polyps at LOW certainty. The cleanest placebo-controlled supplement exposure is the null one. Catalog forms split between oil of oregano and leaf extract, which are not the same exposure.
